text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That was so much fun! I had a great<n>time!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: How was my runnin'? Was it fun to<n>watch?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow, ya sure sound happy! Just<n>hearin' that
makes me happy too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's enjoy our next race too!

Taiki Shuttle's debut race comes to<n>an end. The
following day...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh... It's nice to see you again!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I attended Taiki Shuttle's debut race,<n>and she was
fantastic! She's<n>certainly improved her skills.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Now that the debut race is over, the<n>real competition
awaits...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Have you decided on your next<n>steps?

Every Umamusume has races that<n>align more with
their skills.

I've felt for some time that Taiki<n>Shuttle's speed is
her strong suit.

After watching her debut race, I'm<n>convinced
she'd do well in sprint and<n>mile races.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, is there something bothering you,<n>Trainer?
choice_data_list: Taiki's goal is to become Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'd recommend the Big<n>Eight. Those
races attract a lot of<n>attention, making it easier to
gain<n>favorable reviews.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To be more specific, you could aim for<n>the Classics
or the Tenno Sho.
choice_data_list: (All of those races are far too long for Taiki...)

text_block_list.text:
I can't expect her to place well in<n>races that don't
suit her aptitude...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I get the feeling you're really thinking<n>this over.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
When you can't make up your mind,<n>try walking it
back to the starting line!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Why not go and see what your<n>trainee is up to?

Following Tazuna's advice, I go<n>looking for Taiki
Shuttle.

I find her on the academy grounds<n>practicing hard
by herself.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Nothin' feels better than<n>blazing down the
track!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Are you all set? I'd like to begin.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am. Ready... go!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it ain't Suzuka and Air Groove!<n>Are they
runnin' together?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! If you two are partner<n>runnin', I wanna
join!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Gooo!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What?!

Air Groove and Silence Suzuka are<n>ahead by a few
hundred meters.

Yet Taiki Shuttle closes in on them,<n>coming in at
tremendous speed.

Her powerful legs propel her through<n>the air,
sending clumps of grass<n>spattering against her
face...
I realize what we have to do.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, Trainer! What'd ya wanna<n>talk about?
choice_data_list: I want to discuss our race goals.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good thinkin'! A debut is just the<n>beginning,
after all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So what's our next race gonna be?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Remember, I'm gunnin' to be the<n>next
Umamusume of the Year, and I<n>ain't stopping till I
do!

Taiki's determination is unyielding. I<n>know what
needs to be said...
choice_data_list: Let's master sprint and mile races!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Sprints and miles? Those're the ones<n>around 1,600
meters, right?

Following this path will undoubtedly<n>complicate her
goal of becoming<n>Umamusume of the Year. It won't
be<n>easy.

But even if the odds aren't stacked in<n>her favor...
with legs like hers, she<n>may just come out on top!
choice_data_list: We'll show off your power and speed!
We'll show off your power and speed!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Power and speed?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: My top traits...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeeehaw! I'm pickin' up what<n>you're puttin'
down!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And I gotta say I'm all for it! Let's go<n>smash those
sprints and miles!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So what's up first?!

We now have a path to follow. Our<n>next stop is a
mile race held in Kyoto<n>during winter...
choice_data_list: Let's take on the Shinzan Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! We're gonna train for the<n>Shinzan Kinen till
the cows come<n>home!
